title: DEFINE step 3 PR 7: --litmus <n> and D6 in the biting-stages set
description: src/cli/readiness.js adds the --litmus <n> flag with usage help, parses it via parseLitmusFlag, counts distinct litmus readers at the current tree hash via countLitmusReadersAtHash, and exits 4 with a stderr warn line naming the shortfall when fewer than n have attested. D6 joins the BITING_STAGES set so --check consistency now exits 4 on an unacknowledged D6 failure and 0 when acked at the current hash. --help documents the new flag. No process is spawned and no network call is made.
